city.name: Boston
city.id_namespace_policy: OMDV city, GHSL urban centre, MBTA feed, source TAZ, and H3 IDs remain distinct.

study_area.name: Central Boston
study_area.selection_rule: Physical link geometry intersects the metric-buffered analysis boundary; incident nodes and source connectors are retained with explicit type flags.
study_area.trip_scope: Engineering internal-demand scenario with boundary/gateway status retained; not complete regional traffic.

zones.boundary_rule: Fine cells whose center lies in or on the core boundary; full cells and clipped geometries are both retained.
zones.node_assignment_rule: Physical-node point index at resolution 9; one preferred bidirectional access node per fine cell, otherwise nearest eligible core/analysis physical node with distance recorded.
zones.source_taz_policy: Preserve source TAZ/centroid identity independently from H3 zones.

time.date_alignment_status: Layer-specific dates must be reported; the scenario date does not make source network or GPS contemporaneous.

gps.source: MBTA V3 real-time bus vehicle positions
gps.fallback_policy: No silent engine fallback; failures remain explicit.
gps.osm_tracepoints_attempt_status: api.openstreetmap.org and www.openstreetmap.org timed out on 2026-09-22; no OSM GPS content obtained

gtfs.municipality_metadata_note: Mobility Database catalog records Arlington; do not equate feed ID with Boston or GHSL city IDs.
gtfs.selection_rule: Retain trips serving at least one stop in the analysis boundary and all referenced route/service/shape/stop-time rows.

demand_scenario.generation_basis: OSM building area and deduplicated POI category counts; fallback uses road-node accessibility and cell area with missingness flags.
demand_scenario.mode_share_method: given_mode_share engineering scenario; not a calibrated logit model

assignment.model: static user equilibrium with BPR link cost
